wikidot5e:spell:arcane-gate.effectSummary: Create two linked, 10-foot-diameter portals on ground points you can see: one within 10 feet of you and the other within 500 feet. If either would open in a creature's space, the spell fails and the casting is lost. Each portal is a vertical two-dimensional ring whose active side, chosen by you, is the only visible and functional side. A creature or object entering an active side exits the other portal as though the spaces were adjacent; entering from the back has no effect. The portal mist is opaque and blocks sight. On your turn you can use a bonus action to rotate the rings and change which direction their active sides face.

wikidot5e:spell:arcane-hacking.effectSummary: You have advantage on Intelligence checks made with hacking tools to defeat software encryption or online security on a foreign system. You can also try to break a 2nd-level-or-lower protective spell securing such a system by making an Intelligence check with hacking tools against that spellcaster's save DC. With a slot of 3rd level or higher, you can attempt to counteract a securing spell whose level is no higher than the slot used.

wikidot5e:spell:arcane-lock.effectSummary: A closed door, window, gate, chest, or other entryway you touch becomes magically locked until dispelled. You and creatures you designate at casting can open it normally. You may set a password; speaking it within 5 feet suppresses the lock for 1 minute. Otherwise the object is impassable unless broken or the spell is dispelled or suppressed. Knock suppresses it for 10 minutes. While active, the DC to break the object or pick its locks increases by 10.

wikidot5e:spell:arcane-weapon.effectSummary: Choose one simple or martial weapon you are holding and one of acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, or thunder. Until the spell ends, hits with that weapon deal an extra 1d6 damage of the chosen type; a nonmagical weapon becomes magical for the duration. As a bonus action you can switch the chosen damage type. If cast with a slot of 3rd level or higher, the concentration duration becomes up to 8 hours.

wikidot5e:spell:armor-of-agathys.effectSummary: Gain 5 temporary hit points for 1 hour. While you still have any of these temporary hit points, a creature that hits you with a melee attack takes 5 cold damage. Each slot level above 1st increases both the temporary hit points and the retaliatory cold damage by 5.

wikidot5e:spell:arms-of-hadar.effectSummary: Each other creature within 10 feet of you makes a Strength save. On a failure it takes 2d6 necrotic damage and cannot take reactions until its next turn; on a success it takes half damage and suffers no reaction restriction. A slot above 1st adds 1d6 damage per slot level.

wikidot5e:spell:ashardalons-stride.effectSummary: For the duration, your speed increases by 20 feet and your movement does not provoke opportunity attacks. Whenever you move within 5 feet of a creature or an object that is not worn or carried, it takes 1d6 fire damage; any one creature or object can take this damage only once per turn. Each slot level above 3rd adds 5 feet to the speed increase and 1d6 to the fire damage.

wikidot5e:spell:astral-projection.effectSummary: You and up to eight willing creatures in range project astral forms into the Astral Plane; casting there already causes the spell to fail and the casting to be wasted. Each material body remains unconscious in suspended animation, needing no food or air and not aging. The astral form copies the creature's statistics and possessions and is tethered to its body by a silver cord; only an effect that specifically says it can sever the cord can do so, and severing it kills the creature instantly. Astral forms can travel the Astral Plane and use its portals. Entering another plane, or returning to the original plane, transports the body and possessions along the cord so the creature re-enters its body. Damage and other effects on the astral form do not affect the physical body and do not persist after return. You can dismiss the spell as an action for yourself and your companions, returning affected creatures to their bodies. For an individual creature, the spell also ends if dispel magic succeeds against either its astral or physical body or if either form reaches 0 HP; with an intact cord, its astral form is pulled back and suspended animation ends. If you return prematurely, your companions remain projected and must return independently, commonly by reaching 0 HP.

wikidot5e:spell:augury.effectSummary: Ask about the likely result of a specific course of action you plan to take within the next 30 minutes. The DM gives one omen: weal for good results, woe for bad, both for mixed results, or nothing for neither. The omen does not account for later circumstances that could change the outcome. If you cast augury more than once before your next long rest, each casting after the first has a cumulative 25% chance of producing a random reading; the DM rolls this secretly.

wikidot5e:spell:aura-of-life.effectSummary: A 30-foot-radius aura moves with you. Each nonhostile creature in it, including you, has resistance to necrotic damage and cannot have its hit point maximum reduced. In addition, a nonhostile living creature that starts its turn in the aura at 0 HP regains 1 HP.
